title: Asset
description: Represents an uploaded asset record (e.g. an image, pdf or attachment) for an entity.

assetType.description: This schema defines the type used for describing different types of Attachments.

tabularColumn.description: One column of a tabular file with the statistics the Query Runner read for it, kept as the worker wrote them.

tabularRelation.description: One relation the Query Runner registers from a tabular file: the file itself for a CSV, one per sheet for a workbook.

name.description: Relation name, as registered for a file uploaded under its own name.

tabularProfile.description: How the Query Runner reads a tabular file, taken once after the upload by the worker that later queries it.

error.description: Why the file could not be read, when the read failed. A profile with an error has no relations.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Fully qualified name of a data asset the attachment belongsTo`.

fileName.description: The original file name of the asset.

url.description: URL where the asset is accessible.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes, hex-encoded. Two uploads with the same checksum hold the same file.

dataProfile.description: Structure and statistics of a tabular file, absent until the Query Runner has read it.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been marked for permanent deletion.

entityLink.description: Link to the entity that this asset belongs to.
